agc_driver_pm4 undefined UBSan stops on the misaligned guest word loads of the ASan build's CopyGuestBytes (Execution/src/GuestMemory.cpp); #10973 fixes them.
agc_performance_overlay address,undefined Runs past its 30 s ctest TIMEOUT in the sanitizer build on ubuntu-latest (timed out at 30.18 s); it passes without sanitizers.
atrac9_gradient address,undefined atrac9_gradient_tests does not link in an ANYPS5_ENABLE_ASAN build ('undefined reference to symbol pow'), so ctest reports it as not run; #9710 links it with libm.
guest_backtrace address Fails only in ASan builds, with 'guest backtrace: first frame is not in the calling module'.
guest_convert_keycode undefined LookUp in libSceConvertKeycode/ImeKeyboardType.hpp subtracts 16 from an INT32_MIN keyboard type (signed integer overflow); #10968 fixes it.
guest_getrlimit address The test lowers RLIMIT_DATA to 1 TiB, below the private memory ASan has already mapped, so ASan's next internal mapping fails with ENOMEM ('failed to allocate ... DTLS_NextBlock').
guest_math address,undefined ubuntu-latest's GCC 15 targets x86-64-v3 and fuses libc's float multiply-adds into FMA, so atanf misses the console bits by one ulp; #11059 builds libc with -ffp-contract=off.
guest_posix_spawn address The child raises SIGBUS on purpose to test waitpid, but ASan handles SIGBUS in it and aborts instead; #11239 sets handle_sigbus=0 for this test.
guest_sce_v2_exceptions address The test's inspection hook copies 16 bytes of an 8-byte exception object (heap-buffer-overflow); #10829 fixes the test.
guest_system_configuration undefined The sysctl copy-out calls memcpy with a null source for kern.proc.env; #10921 fixes it.
guest_vorbis_dec undefined The bundled libvorbis left-shifts a negative value (3rdparty/vorbis/lib/psy.c:319); third-party code.
input_magic address Its large-input case runs the relinker under a 512 MiB RLIMIT_AS, where an ASan relinker cannot start; #9711 bounds the input with ASan's allocation cap instead.
